title: Grateful Dead Live at Greek Theatre - University of California on 1989-08-19
lineage: MAC > Nakamichi DR-8 (no Dolby) > Audiophile 2496 analog input > Soundforge > CD-Wave > TLH > FLAC.
source: Sennheiser MD-421's > patched thru one Sony D5 > Sony TC-D5M > Maxell MX-90's, with no Dolby. Mics on six-foot stand in OTS.

ai_review.summary: Audience tape of a hot‑1989 show with a standout Set 2 and Brent’s memorable vocal on “We Can Run”, captured in decent sound quality.
ai_review.review: Both reviewers rave about the performance – the setlist (especially the second set) is praised, and Brent Mydland’s voice on “We Can Run” is highlighted as a emotional high point. The recording is an audience tape that listeners find enjoyable and clear enough to convey the show’s energy.

ai_rating.rationale: High praise for the musical performance (setlist, Brent’s vocals) combined with a generally positive view of the audience recording; two reviews give an average of 4.5 stars.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Described as a "nice audience tape"; no specific flaws mentioned, implying clear enough sound to enjoy the show.

show_quality.setlist_flow: Set 2 is singled out as especially strong, giving the concert a high‑energy peak and contributing to an overall great setlist.

band_member_comments.Keys: Brent Mydland’s voice on “We Can Run” is described as tight‑chest‑moving and memorable.
